svg.title: ParticleLab backward simulation: more paths is not exact uncertainty
svg.desc: All64 variance points for genealogy, backward simulation and exact scalar RTS, plus distinct-index histories. Backward simulation restores two early indices but its time-zero variance is still over twice the exact variance. Fixed development example, not a calibrated uncertainty or budget benchmark.
svg.text: ParticleLab | more paths is not exact uncertainty
Same fixed 64-zero filter: N=32, seed 0, a=.9, process std .4, observation std .1, prior std 2.
512 backward draws, draw seed 0; no new state locations. Development fixture, not a policy or budget ranking.
Time. Teal: backward. Purple dotted: genealogy.
Time. Teal: sampled among 512 backward paths.
Time-0 variance: genealogy 0; backward .022290238; exact .009521314. More diversity is not a guarantee.
Index counts have different sampling definitions. Neither is ESS, independent model-posterior draws or calibration.
Backward simulation connects retained states outside the recorded genealogy, but cannot create missing state support.
